scope.summary: Scoped-grant rewrite: server-owned CHECK OPTION UPDATE template and conjunct-parenthesised DELETE with caller WHERE AND Q AND P, cap validated, caller text kept as AST (no concatenation), reclassification matching the caller verdict, SET/P overlap refused, P/cap mismatch refused; property test, fuzz target, live FREE 23ai proof. 1e9340b7 + test fix fa2b2e59.
out_of_scope: Concurrent cap enforcement, reservation and commit isolation (T13.5); external-client proof w4_request_grant_mr_rewrite_subset_of_p (T13.8).

entry_points.name: guard rewrite suites (orchestrator re-execution)
entry_points.trace: Clean worktree: at 1e9340b7 scoped_grant_rewrite 8/8 (incl. prop_rewrite_never_widens_row_set, 10k cases, asserting exact equality of the selected row set with caller WHERE AND Q AND P over the full small domain, not only subset), scoped_grant_matcher 25/25, effective_dml_plan 9/9; at fa2b2e59 scoped_grant_rewrite 8/8 again. Test bodies read: no-concatenation test proves ') OR (1=1' survives only as a quoted literal; cap 0 and cap > grant cap refused; SET on the predicate column refused before rendering.

entry_points.name: live FREE 23ai (orchestrator re-execution, least-privilege and SYSTEM)
entry_points.trace: At fa2b2e59, ORACLEMCP_LIVE_XE=1 cargo test -p oraclemcp --test scoped_grant_rewrite_live_free23 --features live-xe: 2/2 as E2E_ORACLE and 2/2 as SYSTEM. See live artifact.

limitations: The live tests return early when ORACLEMCP_LIVE_XE is unset, so a default green test run is not live evidence; this close relies on the gated run in the artifact.
UPDATE non-widening is proven by Oracle's CHECK OPTION live (ORA-01402); the offline property test covers DELETE.
